Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We're back, my loyal "Shmirtzies", all... ten of you. And, as I was saying, O.W.C.A. would be nothing without me. My evil helps them exist. (A bell dings.) Wai... Wait. What's this? BeefyMustache55 is calling me a hack? All right, you're going live! Oh, I shoulda known it was you, Francis.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz, you would be nothing without O.W.C.A. foiling your evil, ridiculous ploys.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My sweet misguided Francis, your jobs wouldn't exist without us! (reading the comments) Let's see, "fight it out"... What... What's a "simp"? "Settle it over a soccer match"? That's so random. Hmmm. Whadaya say, BeefyMustache55?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: A bunch of expertly trained athletic field agents versus some haphazard scientists? (chuckles) I am in.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, if L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. wins, you have to shave your mustache!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (gasps) How dare you! When we win, you have to shave your head!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, well, when we win, you have to shave Carl!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Please keep me out of this!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, too late, Carl. A deal's a deal.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, gang, it's time for us to play "Can You Hit That Thing with a Stick?"!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The thing in this case being that rock.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What, may I ask, is this?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Can You Hit That Thing with a Stick! Where we... well, try to hit that thing with a stick.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I guess I should not knock it until I try it?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wow! The thrill of hitting that thing with a stick is like no other!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Truth.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Like no other? What's like no other? What are you guys up to?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whoop, whoop! Ooh, I feel the rush of hitting that thing with a stick!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (approaches the gang) Ugh, are you guys seriously just throwing sticks at things? That is so not bustable. (leaves)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hmmm.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whoa, that's weird. I could throw balls no problem. (gets out a baseball) Watch dis! Dat can! Dat mosquito! Dat Hadron collider!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. Strange we never noticed that.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Now lemme try this stick again.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (falling to his knees) WHYYYYYYYYY?????!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I know what we're gonna do today! We're gonna build a stick-throwing target practice arena! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: He's just over there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. Let's go get some supplies.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on watch) Super code red emergency, Agent P!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The super code red emergency is that our organization, O.W.C.A., has to square off with the evil scientist organization, L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N., in a soccer game.

Name: Carl
Dialog: And I get to be unpaid waterboy!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And I would obviously lend my incredible athleticism to the team, but... I get a little too competitive. It's, uh, not pretty. Anyway, Agent P, get over there and see what Doof's up to. I know he'll find some way to cheat.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, how nice of you to showcase your loyalty to me. You're on... You're on our team, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No? Okay, fine! The L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. team will still be unstoppable! As you know, kicking a ball is now my forte. (He kicks a soccer ball, but misses. Takes out an inator.) Behold, my Bring-Me-A-Ringer-inator, which, as may have deduced, will bring me a superstar soccer player, because, let's be honest, we are athletes of the mind, not the body, obviously. So, our team, y'know, needs a little— (a soccer ball hits him) Ow!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: My bad.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Woo-woo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seriously? You're just tossing slender pieces of wood all day? I'm not upset. I'm just disappointed in you.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ah! Left again! Everything keeps goin' left! I'm cursed!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe it's time we go back to the drawing board and...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (running with sticks like a crazy person) More sticks!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Alright, O.W.C.A., this is for the honor of the agency. Drill time!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh! Agent W pulled a muscle! (to Carl) Get the stretcher! The big one!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Teamwork makes the scheme work! I even convinced Vanessa to show her support.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (flatly) Rah, rah.

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Dink Winkerson here, and out of prison so many times, I've lost count. And I'm out again, and I have a compulsive need to report on the first thing I see. Ooh, a soccer game! That'll do. (He shoves two little girls off a lemonade stand and uses it as an announcer's booth.) And it's a beautiful day for the ultimate contest of good versus evil! (He puts a lemon on his stick.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Francis, prepare to shave your upper lip, and your intern.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're lucky I'm exercising boundaries. Otherwise, you'd be burnt toast, Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah? Let me introduce you to my little friend!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Cristo Fernández?

Name: Cristo Fernández
Dialog: Soccer is life. But more importantly, acting is life.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't gimme that look, Francis. You brought Megan Rapinoe.

Name: Megan Rapinoe
Dialog: Uh, yeah, I'm just here 'cause my house is being tented.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And your misfortune is our fortune.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, lemme get this straight: you're a soccer player turned actor turned actor-soccer player?

Name: Cristo Fernández
Dialog: Si, si, si. But those are just three of my dimensions, I have way more to offer. Like, I'm also devilishly handsome.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: And I'm back in the game! (shakes pom-poms, with more enthusiasm) Rah-rah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, yeah. Listen, you're an actor, so act. If anyone slightly bumps into you, fake an injury. Do a, do a whole soliloquy, just sell it.

Name: Cristo Fernández
Dialog: Hold on a second, so you just want me here to flop? I actually played some professional soccer—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, yeah, I don't need your life story, just flop on the ground like a kid throwing a tantrum.

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Our ref today is Klimpaloon, the Magical Old-Timey Bathing Suit That Lives in the Himalayas!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! I really should have stretched.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, come on! That goal is not regulation size! Enough of this!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Are you serious?

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: (giving a yellow card to Doof) Naaaaaaang...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Moi?!

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: And we're at halftime! Let's talk to the players!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Well, I—

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: The important ones! (to Fernández) Thoughts on the game so far?

Name: Cristo Fernández
Dialog: Good question. I really feel like I found my character's motivation.

Name: Megan Rapinoe
Dialog: (on the phone with the exterminator) What do you mean "structural damage"? Ugh!

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Well, that sounds expensive! And now, a word from our sponsors.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just what we need to help Buford hit his targets. Almost done.

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: And the second half is underway. Agent B takes the ball and flutters it gracefully down the field!

Name: Cristo Fernández
Dialog: ¡Ay, yi, yi, yi, yi, yi, yi! It hurts! It hurst so much! The pain! The drama! Everything— (stops acting) I have representation, I can also do comedy. (back to acting) ¡Ayyyyyyyyy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, no overselling it! Ugh! You were supposed to stay in the game.

Name: Megan Rapinoe
Dialog: Oh, my house is ready!

Name: Megan Rapinoe
Dialog: Byeeeeeeeeeeee!

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Ooh, both teams are down a player! But O.W.C.A. no longer has enough players to even continue the match. They may have to forfeit. That is, unless their coach enters the game.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, Francis? I've been playing this whole time. Are you gonna step up or do you wanna just let me know what shaving cream works best with your skin? (laughs)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, get over here!

Name: Carl
Dialog: You're putting me in?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (pours water over himself) No, I need hydration! I'm going in!

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: In the final seconds, L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. leading by one on a two-on-one breakaway heading toward the keeper. They pass back and forth, forth and back, keeping the platypus on his toes.

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Incredible! The block ties the game!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hit me! Hit me, I'm open! I'm open!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Not today, Heinz!! Not today!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're a monster, Francis!

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: (handing a red card to Monogram) Nang, nang, nang...

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Oooh! Illegal tackle! Doofenshmirtz gets a chance for a penalty kick to win the game!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: It's all on you, Doofenshmirtz! Don't blow it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pressing a remote) Ha ha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on, don't act surprised. I literally just said we're evil, so we have to cheat.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, everyone, time to finish helping Buford hit his target.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aha! Wait. Giant hands? That's not nothing, I guess. I'm getting Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: On the count of three, we'll activate Lenny! (pushes remote) One...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Three!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! (bumps into a wall)

Name: Candace
Dialog: What the? Phineas and Ferb!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yes! I did it! I hit that thing with a stick! Take that, thing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Moving the entire city eight inches to the left was just what Buford needed.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, sticks. They're throwing sticks, sweetie. (leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: But... but, but, but...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What the? No way! How did...

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: Nang, nang, nang... (blows whistle)

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: You heard the referee, tied game! This is Dink Winkerson, going back to prison!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, sportsmanship. Fine.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (grumbles) Okay, fine.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I have to admit, that game reminded me how important L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. is for O.W.C.A. to stay motivated. And it reminded me why I'm behind a desk now. My brain is more stable than my brawn.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, fine, but you didn't win, so I get to shave your mustache.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You didn't win either, so I get to shave your head!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A bet is a bet!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, get back here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Get back!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (screams)
